description: This file defines a Hindi (India) culture information object for DateJS library, providing localized date and time formatting, month and day names, regex patterns, and utility functions for handling dates according to Hindi (India) conventions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current date and time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks whether two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of week given its name in different formats.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name in different formats.
